summary: Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 8, 2026, to announce a conference call and webcast to discuss interim clinical data from the first three patients treated in its U.S. REGAIN trial of Alpha DaRT for recurrent glioblastoma. The filing includes no terms such as price per share, premium, or stake. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are mentioned. As a routine press release about clinical results, it does not constitute a special situation. This filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of operational progress.
